title: New workflow is denied when country pack is draft, expired or suspended.
evidence: Definitions do not look at country packs, so a draft, expired or suspended pack cannot stop a start.

title: A workflow template cannot activate without designated clinical fallbacks for a safety-relevant step.
evidence: Clinical paths cannot be published at all while the clinical switch is off; there is no check for named clinical fallbacks.

title: Run same kernel using two deliberately distinct synthetic country packs.
evidence: The engine does not read packs, so two packs cannot make it behave differently.

title: Definition N+1 is deployed while N workflows are active.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: a change is a new version and running instances stay on theirs.

title: Remove old definition deployment while an N instance is in flight.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: a retired definition keeps running instances going. There is no delete path, and the database refuses deleting a definition an instance uses (not tested).

title: A non-clinical J4 uses its valid payer closure predicate.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: a non-clinical path never invents a review step. There is no payer-specific closure predicate.

title: Unapproved regulated feature toggle is set true manually.
evidence: The clinical switch only decides whether a definition can be published. Nothing checks it, or any approval, when a workflow runs.

title: Authenticated user without required patient relationship starts J2.
evidence: Only staff may start one. Subjects are opaque references, so there is no patient-relationship check.

title: A workflow callback supplies a different cell_id or tenant_id.
evidence: Tenant and cell come from the login or the partner key, never from the body, but no test sends a conflicting value.

title: Revoked delegation sends an otherwise valid step request.
evidence: Engine actors are staff; there is no delegation in a workflow step.

title: Patient match is ambiguous when result arrives.
evidence: No patient matching in the engine.

title: Provider credential expires between request and review.
evidence: Review attestations are references; no provider credential is checked.

title: Same CreateWorkflow request is retried with same key and body.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: starting a workflow with an idempotency key twice gives one instance and the same answer (the second marked as replayed).

title: Same key reused with differing payload.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: the same key with a different request is a conflict and creates nothing; the same idempotency key with a different target is also a conflict.

title: Concurrent transitions use stale expected_version.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: a stale expected version is a conflict and changes nothing. Tested one after the other, not truly in parallel.

title: Unauthorized actor requests CANCELLED state.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: only the owner or an administrator may move; others are refused and nothing changes.

title: Simulated partner transport ACK attempts CLINICAL_REVIEWED.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: every transport and read receipt kind is refused as evidence.

title: HL7 ACK arrives without a named accepting clinical owner.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: acceptance needs an acceptance attestation; a transport acknowledgement is refused.

title: Provider confirms work began but has not produced result.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: each step needs its own evidence kind and cannot be skipped.

title: Signed result correlation does not match patient/order.
evidence: No result correlation to a patient or order.

title: Verified result and valid review attestation match version.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: a review step passes once with the right evidence kind. The attestation itself and its source version are not verified.

title: Signed review arrives with wrong source version.
evidence: No source versions on results.

title: Patient opened report in app but clinician has not reviewed.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: viewed, downloaded and read receipts are refused as evidence.

title: Follow-up email was delivered without receiving provider acceptance.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: email sent and notification delivered are refused as evidence.

title: All journey-specific closure predicates and evidence pass.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: the full path closes once with a closure digest and an intact history.

title: A required safety obligation remains unowned.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: an open exception or an escalation waiting for a person blocks closing. A general 'unowned safety obligation' is not modelled.

title: A pending partner action exists when cancellation occurs.
evidence: No partner actions to reconcile on cancellation.

title: Original report receives a clinically important correction.
evidence: No report corrections or source versions.

title: Partner callback originates from unapproved endpoint/key.
evidence: Partner messages with a bad signature are refused (DEV-131) and a valid one from a disallowed kind is held; they never advance a workflow, because nothing connects them yet.

title: Attestation by valid but wrong-scope clinician arrives.
evidence: No attester scope or relationship check.

title: Audit event source-time precedes processing-time due to delayed delivery.
evidence: A step records one time, not source time and processing time.

title: Evidence ledger is missing a transition reference.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: a workflow whose state, overlay or version disagrees with its history is found and frozen (423). A break in the chain itself uses the shared chain check.

title: Evidence proof is tampered after storage.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: tampering with the stored workflow is found and frozen, and the database refuses editing a step. No incident is raised automatically.

title: Closure export requested by employer without clinical disclosure rights.
evidence: No closure export.

title: Record retention/deletion request conflicts with a lawful hold.
evidence: No retention or lawful-hold handling.

title: Rebuild materialized status from event history.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: state, overlay and version are rebuilt from the history alone and compared.

title: Provider acceptance timer expires without acknowledgment.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: an expired timer marks it at risk and opens an escalation for the owner; nothing accepts automatically.

title: Clinical reviewer unreachable via first channel.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: an unsuccessful try is counted and can hand the escalation to a fallback person; the workflow stays where it was.

title: A timer fires after the step was already completed.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: a timer for a step already left does nothing.

title: Deadline crosses local DST clock change.
evidence: Timers are plain minutes in UTC; calendar and time-zone rules are not supported, and DST is not tested.

title: Escalation channel says delivered but no human reach proof.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: only a person recording that someone was reached closes an escalation.

title: Safety-relevant queue loses designated on-call owner.
evidence: Nothing notices when an owner is deactivated or leaves.

title: Crash after domain commit before outbox publication.
evidence: The engine writes no outbox events, so there is nothing to heal.

title: Bus redelivers same callback multiple times.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: a repeated idempotency key makes one transition, and a repeated partner delivery id is stored once (DEV-131). The two are not connected.

title: Remote provider side-effect outcome unknown.
evidence: A 'reconciling' health state exists and blocks closing, but nothing sets it from an external call.

title: Remote cancellation not acknowledged.
evidence: No external cancellation.

title: Poison event fails parsing repeatedly.
evidence: A partner message that cannot be parsed is held and shown to staff (DEV-131); nothing feeds it into the engine.

title: Delayed event arrives after successor event.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: only the next state is accepted and going back is refused, so a late event cannot move it backwards.

title: Same reference identifier exists in another region.
evidence: One region only; no cross-region identifiers.

title: Cross-border receiver is unapproved while source is valid.
evidence: No cross-border handling.

title: Global observability exporter requests workflow payload.
evidence: Metrics carry route patterns and counts only, no payloads (DEV-130, tested). No exporter or workflow payload exists to test against.

title: Regional failure triggers failover to unauthorized region.
evidence: No failover.

title: Admin tries to enter clinical attestation on partner behalf.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: an administrator cannot enter a review or a handoff for the accountable owner; they must first take responsibility, which is recorded.

title: Operator resolves patient-match exception without evidence.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: an exception or a reconciliation cannot be cleared without evidence of its resolution, only a written reason is refused.

title: Operator presses replay for non-idempotent unknown action.
evidence: There is no replay command for external actions.

title: User of assistive technology reviews workflow status.
evidence: The accessibility scan passes on the Workflow engine page. No assistive-technology review by a person.

title: Patient locale lacks approved emergency text.
evidence: No locale-specific emergency text.

title: SRE tests regional restore with active timer and open safety handoff.
evidence: All state, history and timers are in the database, but no restore with an active timer has been rehearsed.

title: Deactivated partner contract leaves ongoing patients with steps.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: retiring a definition stops new starts. There is no wind-down or handoff plan.

title: Workflow QA matrix contains a missing clinical-safety blocker.
evidence: The release gate and the requirements matrix (GHE-19) are not built.
